name: KubeCon + CloudNativeCon Europe 2027
description: CNCF flagship conference for Kubernetes and cloud-native, with co-located AI days
note: On-site, English; early bird until 2026-11-18 (KubeCon-only individual 360 EUR, corporate 895 EUR, excl. VAT)
details: Four days run by CNCF/Linux Foundation; 15 March is the day of co-located events. The page cites 13,000+ attendees and 350+ sessions. Co-located events include Agentics Day: MCP + Agents, Cloud Native AI + Inference Day, Platform Engineering Day, ArgoCon, BackstageCon, CiliumCon, Observability Day and Open Source SecurityCon. All-Access passes start at 535 EUR (individual, early bird); academic tickets 180-250 EUR.
